name: CANARY CORPS
source:
A clandestine mining operation in deep space has ground to a halt since much more powerful conglomerates discovered their location & seized control. 

To pick the bones of the dead facility & extract every last gram of the priceless mineral Stellisite, Etheridge United Corporations has begun deploying a disposable workforce of pathfinding androids called CANARIES to scout ahead of recovery teams.

For Canary 928, everything seems to be going to plan until she meets her new expedition partner. Will the two of them make it to the deepest reaches of the mine?
...And will they want to go back?

[from [url=https://rattlegeist.itch.io/canary-corps]itch.io[/url] page.]
translation:
深空中的一处秘密采矿基地，在行踪败露并遭实力远超于己的跨国财团强行接管后，彻底陷入了停摆。

为了榨干这座死寂设施的最后一点价值、将无价矿石“星辉石”搜刮殆尽，埃瑟里奇联合企业开始投入一批名为“金丝雀”的消耗型探路仿生人，赶在回收小队之前先行探路。

对金丝雀928号而言，一切原本都在按计划推进——直到她遇见了自己的新探险搭档。她们二人能否顺利抵达矿井最深处？
……抵达之后，她们又是否还想重返地面？
